package.name: realsense_apriltag
package.description: Launch and configuration that point an Intel RealSense D435 at AprilTags: the camera driver, an optional rectification step, and the apriltag_ros detector. Tag poses come out as TF frames named tag_<id>. This package deliberately knows nothing about the robot - it publishes no transform between the camera and any robot link, so the same configuration serves a wrist-mounted and a tripod-mounted camera.
